adoptedNote: Credentials were taken over from another Twitch module ({fields}). They are never displayed. What you type in the settings always takes precedence.
forgotten: Credentials taken over forgotten. Only the settings on this page count now.
share_live: Client id and secret shared with channel “{channel}” (where empty here). They are never shown.
share_copy: Client id and secret shared with channel “{channel}” (saved copy). They are never shown.
share_none: The credentials of channel “{channel}” are not known yet: check that a Twitch channel instance has that channel with its client id and secret, then open a site page and reload.
share_self: “{channel}” is this instance's own channel: type the OTHER channel to take the credentials from.
err_auth: Twitch needs your permission: click “Connect my Twitch channel”.
err_rate: Twitch is limiting requests for now: nothing to do, we try again in a few minutes.
err_network: Twitch is not answering right now: nothing to do, we try again automatically.
err_config_affiliate: Subscriptions are only available to Twitch affiliates and partners.
err_config_credentials: Fill in the Twitch application's ID and secret in “Settings for this feature”.
conn_why: To count your followers and paying subscribers, Twitch first has to ask for your consent. It takes a minute, once.
conn_step1: **1.** On [dev.twitch.tv/console](https://dev.twitch.tv/console), open your Twitch application (or create one: any name, type “Confidential”).
conn_step2: **2.** In the redirect addresses field (“Redirect URLs”), add the address below, then save at Twitch.
conn_step3: **3.** Further down, open “Settings for this feature”: paste the application's ID and secret, then save.
conn_step4: **4.** Click the button below, then “Authorize” at Twitch.
reconnect: Twitch is asking for your permission again: click “Connect my Twitch channel”.
morePermission: You added a number to follow: click “Connect my Twitch channel” so Twitch allows it.
disconnected: Channel disconnected: Twitch can no longer be read with this permission.
disconnectedOffline: Channel disconnected here, but Twitch could not be told. To be sure, remove the access in Twitch (Settings, then Connections).
notReadyCreds: The Twitch application's ID or secret is missing (in “Settings for this feature”, further down). Fill them in and save: the button will appear.
needHttps: Your site's address must start with https:// for Twitch to accept the connection.
chooseOne: Tick at least one number to follow (followers or paying subscribers), then save.
res_denied: You declined the permission at Twitch. Click “Connect my Twitch channel” again, then “Authorize”.
res_refused: Twitch refused the connection. Check your Twitch application's ID, secret and redirect address, then try again.
res_network: Twitch is not answering right now. Try again in a few minutes.
res_rate: Twitch is limiting requests for now. Try again in a few minutes.
res_expired: The connection link had expired (10 minutes). Click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
res_wrongAccount: You signed in at Twitch with the account “{login}”, which is not this channel's. Sign in again with the right Twitch account.
res_scope: A permission is missing at Twitch. Try again and leave every box ticked.
cb_invalid: This connection link is no longer valid. Go back to your site's administration and click “Connect my Twitch channel” again.
